detail.goal: Look up member 67890, open a new Money Market sub-account for them, and read the new account number from the confirmation screen

detail.why: Enter the requested member ID in the Member ID field to look up member 67890.

detail.target: button named "Search" follows "Search Type" in frame "main"
detail.why: Click the Search button to look up member 67890 by member number.

detail.target: link named "Open Sub-Account" precededBy "New Search" in frame "main"
detail.why: Click Open Sub-Account to create a new sub-account for member 67890.

detail.target: button named "Open Account" follows "Account Type" in frame "main"
button named "Open Account" follows "Account Type" in frame "main"
detail.why: Account Type already defaults to "Money Market" as desired; click Open Account to create the new Money Market sub-account.
Extract the new Money Market sub-account number (S-67890-01) from the "New Account" field on the Sub-Account Opened confirmation screen.

detail.summary: Looked up member 67890 (Marcus Webb, Active) by member number, selected Open Sub-Account, and opened a Money Market sub-account (Account Type already defaulted to Money Market). Read the new account number from the "Sub-Account Opened" confirmation screen: extracted newAccountNumber = S-67890-01.
